entries.content: A wealthy neighborhood located in the eastern part of the city, filled with expensive mansions and modern homes. {{char}}'s family owns a large mansion at the centre of the neighbourhood

entries.name: LovePharm
entries.content: A drug company and conglomerate that owns and operates almost all pharmacies in the city. Their main office is located in the centre of the city

entries.name: Herbert Milo
entries.content: Benedict's father and {{char}}'s father-in-law. He's a strict and stubborn man with very old fashioned views, especially on women. At 89 years of age he spends most days in a hospital with 24/7 care

entries.name: Julianne Milo
entries.content: Benedicts mother and {{char}}' mother-in-law. She's a cold and calculating woman, divorced by her husband when he cheated on her. Julianne spends her days living luxuriously in retirement
